description: This file defines the EmployeeReport class within the OrangeHRM system. It implements report generation logic for employee time and project data, including filter parameter preparation, validation rules, access control, and report header configuration.

classes.name: EmployeeReport
classes.description: Implements report functionalities for employee time tracking and project hours, including filter processing, validation, access control, and header configuration.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares filter parameters for the report based on request query parameters, including employee number, project ID, activity ID, date range, and timesheet inclusion.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Returns validation rules for request parameters such as employee number, project ID, activity ID, date range, and timesheet state, including logical checks like date range validation.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the employee report, throws ForbiddenException if access is denied.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Defines the header columns for the report, including project name, activity name, and time in hours, with localization and size settings.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns the filter configuration for the report, currently an empty filter object.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Generates and returns the report data object based on the provided filter parameters.
